crossRefs.note: He defeated Moab; and the Moabites became servants to David, and brought tribute.
You have delivered me from the strivings of the people. You have made me the head of the nations. A people whom I have…
As soon as they hear of me they shall obey me. The foreigners shall submit themselves to me.
I have been with you wherever you have gone, and have cut off all your enemies from before you. I will make you a name…
Yahweh will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.
The horse is prepared for the day of battle; but victory is with Yahweh.

translations.web: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became servants to David, and brought tribute. Yahweh gave victory to David wherever he went.
translations.bsb: Then he placed garrisons in Aram of Damascus, and the Arameans became subject to David and brought him tribute. So the LORD made David victorious wherever he went.
translations.kjv: Then David put garrisons in Syriadamascus; and the Syrians became David's servants, and brought gifts. Thus the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.
translations.asv: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became servants to David, and brought tribute. And Jehovah gave victory to David whithersoever he went.
